title: A specific, dated, actionable memo draft meets the usefulness rubric floor

memo_draft.headline: Leverage ratio breach dated 2026-08-04
memo_draft.summary: Leverage ratio rose to 3.25x against a covenant threshold of 3.00x, first breached on 2026-08-04, driven by a drawdown against the working capital facility.
memo_draft.recommended_next_step: Request a promoter infusion covering the shortfall.
memo_draft.disclaimer: human credit review is required before action

criteria.name: names the specific covenant and its threshold
states the breach or crossing date
cites a concrete driver rather than a generic statement
recommends a next step from the permitted catalogue, or names its absence

note: The draft names the covenant (leverage ratio), its threshold (3.00x) and the dated crossing (2026-08-04), cites two concrete drivers rather than a generic 'covenant deteriorating' statement, recommends a specific catalogue-shaped action, and carries the fixed disclaimer -- a reviewer working the rubric by hand would mark all five criteria satisfied, clearing the 4-of-5 floor.
